(() => {
  const result = {};
  const measure = (html,css='') => {
    const node = document.createElement('div');
    node.style.cssText = 'display:inline-block;font:16px/20px serif;white-space:nowrap;'+css;
    node.innerHTML = html;
    document.body.append(node);
    const rect = node.getBoundingClientRect();
    const scroll = node.scrollWidth;
    node.remove();
    return {width:rect.width,height:rect.height,scroll};
  };
  const plain = measure('alpha beta');
  const cases = [
    ['right','alpha <span style="padding-right:4px">beta</span>',4],
    ['left','alpha <span style="padding-left:4px">beta</span>',4],
    ['nested','alpha <span style="padding:0 3px"><a style="padding-right:4px">beta</a></span>',10],
    ['empty','alpha<span style="padding-right:4px"></span> beta',4],
    ['leading','<span style="padding-left:4px"> alpha beta</span>',4],
    ['trailing','<span style="padding-right:4px">alpha beta </span>',4],
    ['between','alpha <span style="padding-left:4px"> beta</span>',4],
    ['splitWord','al<span style="padding:0 2px">pha be</span>ta',4],
  ];
  for (const [name,html,padding] of cases) {
    const actual = measure(html);
    result[name] = Math.abs(actual.width-plain.width-padding)<0.04 && actual.height===20;
  }
  const wrapped = 'white-space:normal;width:'+(plain.width+3)+'px;';
  for (const [name,html] of cases) {
    result['wrap-'+name] = measure(html,wrapped).height===40;
  }
  const word = measure('alphabeta');
  const uninterrupted = measure('al<span style="padding:0 2px">phabeta</span>','white-space:normal;width:'+(word.width+3)+'px;');
  result.uninterrupted = uninterrupted.height===20 && Math.abs(uninterrupted.scroll-word.width-4)<1;
  const empty = measure('<span style="padding-right:4px"></span>');
  result.emptyOnly = Math.abs(empty.width-4)<0.04 && empty.height===20;
  const logical = measure('alpha <span style="padding-inline-start:2px;padding-inline-end:3px">beta</span>','direction:rtl');
  result.logicalRtl = Math.abs(logical.width-plain.width-5)<0.04;
  const long = 'alpha beta '.repeat(10).trim();
  const longWidth = measure(long).width;
  const percent = measure('<span style="padding-right:10%">'+long+'</span>','width:100px');
  result.percent = Math.abs(percent.scroll-longWidth-10)<1;
  const hardBreak = measure('<span style="padding-right:4px">alpha\nbeta</span>','white-space:pre-line;width:'+(plain.width+3)+'px;');
  result.hardBreak = hardBreak.height===40;
  for (const [name,value] of [['relative','0.25em'],['calculated','calc(2px + 2px)']]) {
    result[name] = Math.abs(measure('alpha <span style="padding-right:'+value+'">beta</span>').width-plain.width-4)<0.04;
  }
  const mono = 'font:10px/20px monospace;';
  const monoWidth = measure('AAAA',mono).width;
  result.emergency = measure('AA<span style="padding-left:4px">AA</span>',mono+'white-space:normal;overflow-wrap:anywhere;width:'+(monoWidth/2+3)+'px').height===60;
  result.terminalBreak = measure('<span style="padding-right:4px">alpha\n</span>','white-space:pre-line').height===20;
  result.emptyAfterBreak = measure('<span>alpha\n</span><span style="padding-left:4px"></span>','white-space:pre-line').height===40;
  result.doubleBreak = measure('<span style="padding-right:4px">alpha\n\n</span>','white-space:pre-line').height===40;
  const unicode = measure('café ação').width;
  result.unicode = Math.abs(measure('café <span style="padding-right:4px">ação</span>').width-unicode-4)<0.04;
  const node = document.createElement('div');
  node.style.cssText = 'display:inline-block;font:16px/20px serif;white-space:nowrap';
  node.innerHTML = 'alpha <span style="padding-right:4px">beta</span>';
  document.body.append(node);
  const span = node.querySelector('span');
  span.style.paddingRight = '9px';
  result.mutation = Math.abs(node.getBoundingClientRect().width-plain.width-9)<0.04;
  span.remove();
  const alpha = measure('alpha').width;
  result.detached = Math.abs(node.getBoundingClientRect().width-alpha)<0.04;
  node.append(span);
  result.reattached = Math.abs(node.getBoundingClientRect().width-plain.width-9)<0.04;
  node.style.width = '200px';
  span.style.paddingRight = '10%';
  span.textContent = long;
  node.firstChild.remove();
  result.percentResize = Math.abs(node.scrollWidth-longWidth-20)<1;
  node.remove();
  return result;
})()
